data_source.query:
FROM jma-daily
| WHERE prefecture == ?pref
| STATS t = AVG(temp_avg), tx = AVG(temp_max), tn = AVG(temp_min), p = SUM(precip_total),
    nt = COUNT(temp_avg), ntx = COUNT(temp_max), ntn = COUNT(temp_min), np = COUNT(precip_total), days = COUNT(*)
  BY year, month
| EVAL t = CASE(nt >= days * 0.8, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ntx >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ntn >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(np >= days * 0.8, ROUND(p, 1))
| STATS t = AVG(t), tx = AVG(tx), tn = AVG(tn), p = SUM(p),
    ct = COUNT(t), ctx = COUNT(tx), ctn = COUNT(tn), cp = COUNT(p) BY year
| EVAL t = CASE(ct == 12, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ctx == 12, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ctn == 12, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(cp == 12, ROUND(p, 1))
| STATS v = AVG(t)

FROM jma-daily
| WHERE prefecture == ?pref
| STATS t = AVG(temp_avg), tx = AVG(temp_max), tn = AVG(temp_min), p = SUM(precip_total),
    nt = COUNT(temp_avg), ntx = COUNT(temp_max), ntn = COUNT(temp_min), np = COUNT(precip_total), days = COUNT(*)
  BY year, month
| EVAL t = CASE(nt >= days * 0.8, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ntx >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ntn >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(np >= days * 0.8, ROUND(p, 1))
| STATS t = AVG(t), tx = AVG(tx), tn = AVG(tn), p = SUM(p),
    ct = COUNT(t), ctx = COUNT(tx), ctn = COUNT(tn), cp = COUNT(p) BY year
| EVAL t = CASE(ct == 12, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ctx == 12, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ctn == 12, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(cp == 12, ROUND(p, 1))
| STATS v = AVG(t) WHERE year >= 2016, base = AVG(t)
| EVAL diff = v - base

FROM jma-daily
| WHERE prefecture == ?pref
| STATS t = AVG(temp_avg), tx = AVG(temp_max), tn = AVG(temp_min), p = SUM(precip_total),
    nt = COUNT(temp_avg), ntx = COUNT(temp_max), ntn = COUNT(temp_min), np = COUNT(precip_total), days = COUNT(*)
  BY year, month
| EVAL t = CASE(nt >= days * 0.8, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ntx >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ntn >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(np >= days * 0.8, ROUND(p, 1))
| STATS t = AVG(t), tx = AVG(tx), tn = AVG(tn), p = SUM(p),
    ct = COUNT(t), ctx = COUNT(tx), ctn = COUNT(tn), cp = COUNT(p) BY year
| EVAL t = CASE(ct == 12, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ctx == 12, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ctn == 12, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(cp == 12, ROUND(p, 1))
| WHERE t IS NOT NULL
| EVAL x = TO_DOUBLE(year - 2000)
| STATS n = COUNT(*), sx = SUM(x), sy = SUM(t), sxy = SUM(x * t), sxx = SUM(x * x)
| EVAL trend = (n * sxy - sx * sy) / (n * sxx - sx * sx) * 10
| KEEP trend

config.title: 都道府県の比較：年平均気温（上の「比較する都道府県」で選択）

data_source.query:
FROM jma-daily
| WHERE MV_CONTAINS(?prefs, prefecture)
| STATS t = AVG(temp_avg), tx = AVG(temp_max), tn = AVG(temp_min), p = SUM(precip_total),
    nt = COUNT(temp_avg), ntx = COUNT(temp_max), ntn = COUNT(temp_min), np = COUNT(precip_total), days = COUNT(*)
  BY prefecture, year, month
| EVAL t = CASE(nt >= days * 0.8, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ntx >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ntn >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(np >= days * 0.8, ROUND(p, 1))
| STATS t = AVG(t), tx = AVG(tx), tn = AVG(tn), p = SUM(p),
    ct = COUNT(t), ctx = COUNT(tx), ctn = COUNT(tn), cp = COUNT(p) BY prefecture, year
| EVAL t = CASE(ct == 12, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ctx == 12, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ctn == 12, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(cp == 12, ROUND(p, 1))
| KEEP year, prefecture, t
| SORT year

config.title: 一覧（列見出しで並べ替え。直近10年 = 2016〜2025年）

data_source.query:
FROM jma-daily
| STATS t = AVG(temp_avg), tx = AVG(temp_max), tn = AVG(temp_min), p = SUM(precip_total),
    nt = COUNT(temp_avg), ntx = COUNT(temp_max), ntn = COUNT(temp_min), np = COUNT(precip_total), days = COUNT(*)
  BY prefecture, station, year, month
| EVAL t = CASE(nt >= days * 0.8, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ntx >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ntn >= days * 0.8, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(np >= days * 0.8, ROUND(p, 1))
| STATS t = AVG(t), tx = AVG(tx), tn = AVG(tn), p = SUM(p),
    ct = COUNT(t), ctx = COUNT(tx), ctn = COUNT(tn), cp = COUNT(p) BY prefecture, station, year
| EVAL t = CASE(ct == 12, ROUND(t, 1)), tx = CASE(ctx == 12, ROUND(tx, 1)),
    tn = CASE(ctn == 12, ROUND(tn, 1)), p = CASE(cp == 12, ROUND(p, 1))
| EVAL xt = CASE(t IS NOT NULL, TO_DOUBLE(year - 2000))
| STATS allT = AVG(t), recT = AVG(t) WHERE year >= 2016, allP = AVG(p), recP = AVG(p) WHERE year >= 2016,
    n = COUNT(t), sx = SUM(xt), sy = SUM(t), sxy = SUM(xt * t), sxx = SUM(xt * xt) BY prefecture, station
| EVAL diffT = recT - allT, trend = (n * sxy - sx * sy) / (n * sxx - sx * sx) * 10
| EVAL no = CASE(prefecture == "北海道", 1, prefecture == "青森県", 2, prefecture == "岩手県", 3, prefecture == "宮城県", 4, prefecture == "秋田県", 5, prefecture == "山形県", 6, prefecture == "福島県", 7, prefecture == "茨城県", 8, prefecture == "栃木県", 9, prefecture == "群馬県", 10, prefecture == "埼玉県", 11, prefecture == "千葉県", 12, prefecture == "東京都", 13, prefecture == "神奈川県", 14, prefecture == "新潟県", 15, prefecture == "富山県", 16, prefecture == "石川県", 17, prefecture == "福井県", 18, prefecture == "山梨県", 19, prefecture == "長野県", 20, prefecture == "岐阜県", 21, prefecture == "静岡県", 22, prefecture == "愛知県", 23, prefecture == "三重県", 24, prefecture == "滋賀県", 25, prefecture == "京都府", 26, prefecture == "大阪府", 27, prefecture == "兵庫県", 28, prefecture == "奈良県", 29, prefecture == "和歌山県", 30, prefecture == "鳥取県", 31, prefecture == "島根県", 32, prefecture == "岡山県", 33, prefecture == "広島県", 34, prefecture == "山口県", 35, prefecture == "徳島県", 36, prefecture == "香川県", 37, prefecture == "愛媛県", 38, prefecture == "高知県", 39, prefecture == "福岡県", 40, prefecture == "佐賀県", 41, prefecture == "長崎県", 42, prefecture == "熊本県", 43, prefecture == "大分県", 44, prefecture == "宮崎県", 45, prefecture == "鹿児島県", 46, prefecture == "沖縄県", 47)

config.content: 出典：気象庁「過去の気象データ・ダウンロード」の日別値（`data/raw` の CSV を Logstash で取り込み）。品質情報 5 未満の値は取り込み時に除外。日数が 8 割未満の月、12 か月そろわない年は空欄。年平均気温は月平均気温の平均（HTML ビューアと同じ計算）。
